answers.reason: The elected student representative holds a faculty-level mandate and is not mentioned as having a seat in the central university senate.
Central budget allocation is handled by university leadership and administration without seats for faculty student representatives.
As the elected representative for the faculty's students, this person holds a statutory student seat on faculty appointment committees.
The elected student representative of the faculty holds an office specifically meant to represent students in the faculty council.
Advising the faculty council on teaching and degree programmes directly involves the elected student representative of the faculty.
Faculty examination boards formally include a student representative seat, which this office holder is permitted to fill.
Internal research funding rounds are restricted to academic staff and leadership, without student representation.
As an office holder in the faculty's study governance, the student representative may take part in subordinate working groups revising study modules.
Equipment procurement within a fixed budget is an administrative and faculty staff matter where student representatives have no designated seat.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a lower-level student and teaching affair in which the elected student representative is permitted to participate.
